question: How are initiated persons of all castes identified with Mahādeva?
premises: Mahādeva is spoken of in a certain way.
Initiated persons belong to various castes.
Initiated persons are spoken of in the same way as Mahādeva.
inference: Initiation establishes an identity or equivalence between the initiated and Mahādeva across castes.
plain_english: Just as Mahādeva is spoken of, so indeed are the initiated of all castes.
